const r = await tools.exec_command({"cmd":"env LUA_PATH="$TOME_LUAROCKS_ROOT/share/lua/5.1/?.lua;$TOME_LUAROCKS_ROOT/share/lua/5.1/?/init.lua;;" LUA_CPATH="$TOME_LUAROCKS_ROOT/lib/lua/5.1/?.so;;" "$TOME_LUAJIT" -e '
local function read_current(path)
  local f = assert(io.open(path, "rb")); local s = assert(f:read("*a")); f:close(); return s
end
local function read_head()
  local p = assert(io.popen("git show HEAD:tome-cults.lua", "r")); local s = assert(p:read("*a")); assert(p:close()); return s
end
local function repr(v)
  if type(v) ~= "table" then return type(v) .. ":" .. tostring(v) end
  local out = {"{"}; for i = 1, #v do out[#out+1] = repr(v[i]); out[#out+1] = "," end; out[#out+1] = "}"; return table.concat(out)
end
local function capture(text, name)
  local rows, current_section = {}, nil
  local prior_t, prior_section = t, section
  t = function(source, target, source_tag, args_order)
    rows[#rows+1] = {source=source, target=target, source_tag=source_tag, args_order=repr(args_order), section=current_section}
  end
  section = function(value) current_section = value end
  local chunk, err = loadstring(text, name); assert(chunk, err); chunk()
  t, section = prior_t, prior_section
  return rows
end
local before = capture(read_head(), "@HEAD:tome-cults.lua")
local after = capture(read_current("tome-cults.lua"), "@tome-cults.lua")
assert(#before == #after, ("record count drift: %d -> %d"):format(#before, #after))
local changed = 0
for i = 1, #before do
  local a, b = before[i], after[i]
  assert(a.source == b.source, "source drift at record " .. i)
  assert(a.source_tag == b.source_tag, "source_tag drift at record " .. i)
  assert(a.args_order == b.args_order, "args_order drift at record " .. i)
  assert(a.section == b.section, "section drift at record " .. i)
  if a.target ~= b.target then changed = changed + 1 end
end
assert(changed == 21, "expected exactly 21 target changes, got " .. changed)
print(("PASS LuaJIT record comparison: %d records, exactly %d target changes, all non-target fields unchanged"):format(#before, changed))
' && git diff --check","workdir":"/workspace/tome4-chinese-translation","yield_time_ms":30000,"max_output_tokens":10000,"sandbox_permissions":"require_escalated","justification":"允许我运行 LuaJIT 相对 HEAD 的逐记录有界验证及 git diff --check 吗？"});
